cases.title: Edit Pipe lowers the pipe into pit B and Recalculate downstream keeps pit B's 50 mm drop on the pipe leaving it; the next pipe, with a blank end level, is skipped and named instead of being given a level below zero
cases.plan_item: BUG-proof wave 1, group E (Edit Pipe 'Recalculate downstream'); BUG-652 and BUG-653
cases.expected: Four pits A, B, C, D and three pipes A->B (18.500 / 18.400), B->C (18.350 / 18.250), C->D (18.200 / blank). Select A->B, CDEDIT, set the levels 18.500 / 18.200, Save, answer Yes to 'Recalculate downstream inverts?', Apply in Cascade Preview. The command line says '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Updated 1 pipes and 1 pits from ... (IL 18.20). Min grade: 1:...' and '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Warning: Skipping pipe ... - it has no level at one end. Fill the level in and run this again to carry the change past it.' Pipe B->C now reads IL 18.15 and IL 18.05 (the 50 mm drop at B kept); no text reads IL 18.10 (the no-drop answer); exactly one text reads IL 18.05 (C->D was not touched); no IL text is below zero. The CE log has 'IL=18.20 pipes=1 pits=1'. No CE window is left open and the drawing file is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: PropagationCascadeHuntTests prove the walk on a made-up graph; only the live drawing shows that Edit Pipe really hands the level from BEFORE its own save to the walk (the review HIGH of c14f04c8), that a blank level drawn by New Pipe reaches the walk as Unknown, and that the drawn IL texts follow.
not_automated: CDPROPAGATE (the other route named in BUG-653, the upstream walk and its downstream fallback) is NOT driven: it asks for the anchor pit by an entity pick, and a typed pick on a pit outline is an unproven route. The skip is the same code (InvertPropagation.cs 309-318) for both directions. Codex look or a later case.
The junction rule (BUG-655, lowest arriving pipe at a pit with two inlets) and the hand-typed-level check (BUG-654) are not part of this case.
Which IL text belongs to which pipe end is not mapped by handle: the case counts texts by their wording among the objects it drew. Pit C's schedule level (18.05) is not read.
